about.title: Good advice. Great electronics.
about.intro: Choosing an appliance should feel simple. Our catalogue brings the physical shop experience online, so you can explore your options before talking to our team.
about.mission: Help customers find electronics that fit their needs and budget, with clear information and useful product guidance.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.notice: Editable starter policy. Review and approve before launch.

sections.title: Information you choose to share
sections.body: This website has no accounts, payment forms or backend contact-form storage. Sending an inquiry on WhatsApp shares the information you enter with the business through WhatsApp.

sections.title: External services
sections.body: WhatsApp, social platforms and maps have their own privacy policies. Hosting providers may process technical logs such as IP addresses to operate and protect the website.

sections.title: Local browser storage
sections.body: Recently viewed product identifiers are stored in your browser when available. Clear site data to remove them. No analytics or advertising trackers are included.

sections.title: Questions and retention
sections.body: Contact the business to discuss privacy, correction or deletion of inquiry information. The business must confirm its retention practices before publishing this policy.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.notice: Editable starter terms. Review before launch; this is not professional legal advice.

sections.title: Catalogue information
sections.body: Products, images, specifications, prices and stock indicators require confirmation. Demo information is illustrative and is not a verified offer.

sections.title: Purchase inquiries
sections.body: A WhatsApp inquiry is not an accepted order, payment or stock reservation. Confirm the product, variant, price, warranty and delivery or pickup before a sale is agreed.

sections.title: Warranty, delivery and returns
sections.body: Confirm applicable warranty, delivery charges, pickup arrangements and return or exchange terms directly with the shop before purchase.

sections.title: Brands and images
sections.body: Brand names are catalogue labels and do not imply authorized dealership, partnership or endorsement. Demo illustrations do not depict an exact manufacturer model.
